name: Shibarare Nurse
source:
Main character is a guard at a hospital who protects nurses from suspicious persons. However, he has other side of personality - at night time he aims at late-shift nurses with the aim to tie them up and make photos of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是医院保安，负责保护护士免受可疑人物侵害。但他还有另一面：夜晚，他会盯上值夜班的护士，把她们绑起来拍照。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
